::: {.callout-important title="Current status"}
This project is an exploratory openMSE demonstration. Its original SCA fit uses
observations through 2024. The October 2026 review audits newer files and identifies
the work required for an updated operating model. A completed 2026 refit and an
endorsed management procedure remain pending.
:::

The [historical walkthrough](reports/historical-walkthrough.html) explains how
pollock catches, survey indices, and catch-at-age enter SAMtool, how an assessment
is passed to `Assess2OM`, and how four example management procedures are compared.
It is preserved as a January 2026 rendered snapshot, with a review notice.

The [evaluation](reports/evaluation.qmd) identifies scientific and reproducibility
issues in that document. The [updated-input audit](reports/updated-inputs.qmd)
checks actual file contents and the published September 2026 Model 26.0 diagnostic
tables. The [next steps](reports/next-steps.qmd) specify the inputs, comparisons,
and acceptance criteria needed to move to a current MSE.

## Findings that determine the next run

1. The demo cache covers **1964–2024**, with a **15+** terminal age bin.
2. The candidate `pm_25.dat` contains 2025 data, but its annual weight matrices have
   **61 and 63 rows for a 62-year model**. Reconcile the source before fitting.
3. The candidate `pm_26.dat` still ends in **2024**. Its core inputs match the demo
   cache; its filename supplies no evidence of a 2026 data update.
4. The 2026 BTS workbook contains current abundance-at-age rows, but its older
   `Index` and `AgeComps` sheets end in 2024. Select a product and geographic area
   explicitly before using the workbook.
5. The published Model 26.0 point estimate meets the gradient and Hessian checks;
   its posterior diagnostic table and several retrospective gradients require
   further work before uncertainty draws become the OM ensemble.

## What this release verifies

The input audit was run in a fresh R session. The website is rebuilt from saved
audit tables and public diagnostic exports; rendering does not refit assessments
or rerun simulations. Input fingerprints and downloads are available in the
[audit](reports/updated-inputs.qmd#provenance). Model compilation, a new SCA fit,
and a closed-loop 2026 MSE were not run in this release: MSEtool, SAMtool, and Slick
are absent from the inspected R environment.

This working paper uses Quarto directly and follows staged source, audit-output,
report, and release responsibilities. An `asar` SAFE template is unnecessary for
this focused MSE review. This project has no current ABC/OFL recommendation.
